onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/properties/graph_vars.schema.json, set an_c_yaw_enabled to {{an_c_yaw_enabled}}]
Set whether MovementDirectionYaw is computed and written to the animator each frame to {{an_c_yaw_enabled}}. Used for strafe blend trees.

elements.label: Speed
elements.value: float — horizontal XZ velocity magnitude from MovementAbility.getHorizontalSpeed()

elements.label: IsGrounded
elements.value: bool — direct ground contact from CharacterStateMachine.isGrounded()

elements.label: IsRecentlyGrounded
elements.value: bool — near-ground proximity within groundedThreshold distance

elements.label: IsJumping
elements.value: bool — true when CharacterStateMachine state == Jumping

elements.label: JumpTrigger
elements.value: trigger — fires requestTransition on JumpStartedEvent receipt

elements.label: MovementDirectionYaw
elements.value: float — angle between character forward and movement direction (degrees)
